informal:
It's equivalent to 
 $5(a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca)\geq (a+b+c)^3+18abc\iff$
 $2\sum_{sym}a^2b\geq a^3+b^3+c^3+9abc$
Setting $a=y+z$ , $b=z+x$ , $c=x+y$ , the inequality reduces to 
 $2(x^3+y^3+z^3+3xyz-\sum_{sym}x^2y)\geq0$
which is Schur. $ lacksquare$
